Scope and onboarding

Capability-based routing
Enable external AI projects for an entitled independent software client; test owned EduVerse and AppNAI.

XS-03
Concurrent workflows
Create 20 runs; change published config and workflow; tick one run and pause another.
Independent run state, immutable revision references and no unauthorized actions.
XS-04
Event replay and conflict
Replay event E1 twice; enqueue two identical actions for the same relationship.
Single logical event and one eligible action; competing action held or suppressed.
XS-05
Omnichannel suppression
Receive permitted email and WhatsApp sample replies, then opt out.

XS-06
Budget and recovery
Set remaining budget below estimated charge; mark a provider outcome unknown.
No overspend; reconcile uncertain outcome before retry; bounded retries.
XS-07
Shared closure state
Create an approved synthetic commercial quotation; inspect CRM pipeline and authorized customer portal projection.
Consistent opportunity, quotation and order IDs; calculated prices and verified payment status only from committed evidence.
XS-08
Website and Admin handoff
Register SaaS client and export sample application; import into authorized Admin; publish approved snapshot.
Distinct identities; explicit synthetic handoff; no private Admin export to public website.
XS-09
Configuration lifecycle
Approve configuration revision 2; suspend startup; rollback configuration.
New runs use approved revision; existing runs retain snapshot; suspended work blocked; rollback audited.
XS-10
Accessibility and navigation
Visit every catalog route; keyboard navigate forms, errors, filters and detail links at desktop/mobile widths.
No broken route or JS error; correct focus and accessible labels; scoped fields and readable layout.
